# Sharp External Corners

Convex intersections of surfaces without a radius.

<figure markdown="span">
![Sharp External Corners: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/sharp-external-corners-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Sharp External Corners: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/sharp-external-corners-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Convex edges without a radius, which are fragile and hard to produce.</figcaption>
</figure>

| Process | Criticality |

## Values

This rule has no number to meet: when it finds the problem, it reports it as the error or warning set here.

Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | If detected | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | Warning | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    External Sharp Corner (`{measured}`): This external sharp corner creates a sharp internal corner in the mold cavity that cannot be CNC machined and requires EDM (Electrical Discharge Machining). Unless this edge lies on the parting line or is perpendicular to the pull direction, an external fillet of radius at least 0.5mm is recommended to reduce tooling cost and lead time.
